title: Black Friday Deals Are Already Live on the Two Gadgets That Actually Solve an Apartment's Floor-Space Problem
intro: Black Friday proper is still ten days off (November 27), but the gardening-gear sales are already running, and this year two of the markdowns are aimed squarely at the problem apartment growers actually have — not enough floor space for the number of plants they want. GreenStalk's own site is running a site-wide Black Friday sale right now through December 3, and retailer Botanical Interests has GreenStalk's stacking vertical planters at 25% off — the 7-tier down to $126.75 from $169.00, the 5-tier down to $111.75 from $149.00. Separately, Spider Farmer's own store has its 4-tier plant stand with built-in 108W grow lights marked down to $152.99 from $169.99. The two products solve the same floor-space problem in opposite ways — one leans on a bright window, the other brings its own light — and which one is worth the money depends entirely on which kind of apartment you're growing in.

sections.heading: If you have one genuinely bright window: the GreenStalk stacking planter
sections.body: A GreenStalk is five or seven planter tiers stacked on a single central pole with a built-in watering column that lets you pour into the top and have it reach every tier, so the whole thing occupies about the same floor footprint as a single large houseplant pot while holding enough cells for a real herb or leafy-green collection. The catch, and it's a real one for apartments, is that it has no supplemental lighting at all — it's a planter, not a grow light, so it only works where a window is already putting out strong, mostly-unobstructed light most of the day. Put it somewhere dim and you'll get the same leggy, reaching growth you'd get from any houseplant in low light, just spread across seven tiers instead of one pot. The current markdown (7-tier $126.75, down from $169.00; 5-tier $111.75, down from $149.00, per Botanical Interests' Black Friday listing, with GreenStalk's own site also running a site-wide sale through Dec. 3) makes it one of the few ways to turn a single sunny windowsill into a dozen-plus planting slots without adding a single extra piece of furniture.

products.name: GreenStalk 7-Tier Vertical Planter
products.blurb: Seven stacked planter tiers on one pole with an internal watering column, so one pour at the top waters every tier — the highest plant-slot-per-square-foot option here, but it depends entirely on an actual bright window since it has no built-in light.
products.priceNote: Currently discounted to roughly $126.75 from a $169.00 list price via Botanical Interests' Black Friday sale; GreenStalk's own site is also running a site-wide Black Friday discount through Dec. 3.

sections.heading: If your best spot is a dim corner: a plant stand with its own grow lights
sections.body: Spider Farmer's 4-tier plant stand flips the GreenStalk's assumption entirely — instead of relying on a window, each of its four shelves has its own integrated 108W full-spectrum LED bar mounted underneath the shelf above it, so the whole unit creates its own grow-light conditions regardless of where in the apartment it sits. That makes it the better pick for the common apartment situation GreenStalk can't solve: a hallway, a north-facing room, or a corner that's simply too far from any window to count as bright light. It also means a real ongoing electricity cost that a planter doesn't have, and four shelves of plants under direct LED bars is a meaningfully bigger piece of furniture than a slim pole planter, so it needs an actual corner to live in rather than a windowsill. At its current markdown — $152.99, down from $169.99 list, per Spider Farmer's own store listing — it's one of the more affordable ways into a genuine indoor grow-light setup rather than a single clip-on grow bulb.

products.name: Spider Farmer 4-Tier Plant Stand with Grow Lights
products.blurb: A 4-shelf plant stand with an integrated 108W full-spectrum LED bar under each upper shelf, so it supplies its own grow light rather than depending on a window — the right pick for a dim corner or hallway that a stacking planter can't grow anything in.
products.priceNote: Currently listed at $152.99, down from a $169.99 list price, on Spider Farmer's own store.
products.searchQuery: Spider Farmer 4-Tier Plant Stand with Grow Lights

conclusion: Neither of these is the universal answer — a GreenStalk in a dim corner will grow just as poorly as any other plant stuck in low light, and a grow-light stand on a bright windowsill is paying an electric bill for light you already had for free. The useful question before buying either one this week is honest: do you actually have a window that stays bright most of the day, or are you working with a corner that doesn't? Answer that first, then buy accordingly — and since both of these discounts are live now, more than a week before Black Friday itself, there's no reason to wait for the 27th assuming the markdown holds (it's worth a quick price check the morning you buy, since early-access sale pricing can shift once the official Black Friday week starts).
